events.description: MINUTE ORDER (by docket entry only). For the reasons discussed at the October 9, 2024 hearing in this matter, the Court GRANTS Proposed Intervenor Defendants Republican National Committee and Georgia Republican Party, Inc.'s Motion to Intervene, pursuant to Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 24(b). [Doc. 17]. Additionally, the Court CONSTRUES Plaintiffs' Motion for Temporary Restraining Order [Doc. 2] as Motion for Temporary Restraining Order and for Preliminary Injunction. The Court DENIES Plaintiffs' Motion for Temporary Restraining Order and DEFERS ruling on the Motion for Preliminary Injunction. As discussed at the hearing, the Court SCHEDULES an evidentiary hearing on the Motion for Preliminary Injunction [Doc. 2] for October 10, 2024, at 2:00 p.m., in Courtroom 1708, United States Courthouse, 75 Ted Turner Drive, S.W., Atlanta, GA, 30303. During the hearing, each side shall have no more than one hour to present its argument and evidence to the Court. Finally, the Court DIRECTS Defendants, including Intervenor Defendants, to file their oppositions to Plaintiff's Motion for Preliminary Injunction by October 10, 2024, at noon. The opposition of Defendants Governor Brian Kemp and Secretary of State Brad Raffensperger may be filed separately from the opposition of the Intervenor Defendants, with each opposition brief not exceeding twenty-five (25) pages. The Court also DIRECTS the Parties to file briefs, not to exceed five (5) pages per side, on the issue of standing by October 10, 2024, at noon. Approved by District Judge Eleanor L. Ross on 10/10/24. (mlb)
